format_note: PROPOSED nonproduction lifecycle contract, 0710/05.03. Not an authority source: each stage cites the law that owns it. Fixture approvals are SYNTHETIC.

identities.staged_sha256: bytes of the candidate as staged (compute)
identities.content_sha256: bytes with the mutable stamp lines removed: lines beginning 'Authorization:' and 'state:' in the header before the first '## ' (compute)
identities.approved_sha256: the signed_sha256 the Director's approval names (Director record; compute verifies)
identities.retired_sha256: the old seat's bytes after the retired stamp (compute)
identities.seat_before_sha256: the old seat's bytes before any change (compute; rollback target)

mechanical_transitions.allowed: only the two mutable stamp lines change; content_sha256 must be equal before and after

sign.state: signed. {by}; compute checks passed. Not approved.

warehouse.proposal: 00.retire.09/{PPPP.title}/{FF}.{VVV}.09.md inside the book; the page folder keeps the originating identity so equal FF.VVV names from different pages cannot collide
warehouse.ledger: 00.retire.09/09.md, one line per retirement: page, face, retired file, version retired, retired by version, seat_before_sha256, retired_sha256, approval ref, date
warehouse.law_status: 0009 says move the face into this book's 00.retire.09 and is silent on its layout; the page subfolder is a proposal needing approval, not an existing permission

inputs.page: book/PPPP.title (intelligence names it; compute resolves it)
inputs.candidate_file: the reviewed candidate bytes (from the work page evidence)
inputs.source_seat_sha256: the seat the candidate was drafted from
inputs.grounds: the work references: decision, review and job pages
inputs.release: the pair or set of faces that seat together

stages.owner: model or Prime under a job; compute writes
stages.emits: stage record {page, face, draft_file, staged_sha256, content_sha256, source_seat_sha256, grounds}
stages.correction: re-stage only to a free draft name; never overwrite

stages.owner: model requests; compute checks and stamps
stages.correction: a failed align check leaves the draft unsigned; fix by a new draft
the Director records a new approval of the exact signed bytes

stages.emits: journal entries J1-J5 and a seat record {seated_sha256, retired_sha256, warehouse_file}
stages.writes: J1 journal; J2 warehouse page folder and ledger line; J3 rename the seat into the warehouse, then the retired stamp; J4 rename the draft to FF, then the approved stamp; J5 read back
stages.correction: restart from the journal: each step checks the actual source and destination hashes; a step label alone never authorizes a rename

stages.emits: rollback record; both versions restored and kept
stages.writes: move the retired face back and restore seat_before bytes; rename the seat back to its draft name and restore the signed bytes; the ledger line is struck, not deleted

not_in_this_template: any copy in place of a rename
